title: Fainting / feeling faint (Earth reference, no space data)

steps.text: Make sure the crewmember is safe and cannot be hurt if they lose consciousness.

source.guideline: Zideman DA, Singletary EM, Borra V, et al. European Resuscitation Council Guidelines 2021: First aid. Resuscitation. 2021;161:270-290. doi:10.1016/j.resuscitation.2021.02.013 (Earth reference, no space data)

steps.text: Coach the crewmember to use physical counterpressure manoeuvres. Lower-body manoeuvres (squatting, with or without leg crossing) work better than upper-body ones (hand clenching, neck flexion).

source.guideline: Zideman DA, Singletary EM, Borra V, et al. European Resuscitation Council Guidelines 2021: First aid. Resuscitation. 2021;161:270-290. doi:10.1016/j.resuscitation.2021.02.013 (Earth reference, no space data)

steps.text: If they respond less but do not need CPR, place them on their side in the recovery position.

source.guideline: Djärv T, Rogers J, Semeraro F, et al. European Resuscitation Council Guidelines 2025 First Aid. Resuscitation. 2025;215:110752. doi:10.1016/j.resuscitation.2025.110752 (Earth reference, no space data)
